headings: Take your puppy home the same day
text: How it works Whether you choose to visit us locally or order a premium breed from overseas, TeddyPups is here to make the experience unforgettable. 1 Two ways home 2 Our premium puppy promise 3 Delivery & collection 4 Why choose us choose your way Two ways home In Dubai meet in person Imported order upon request Meet your puppy in person Step into our Downtown Dubai showroom and experience the joy of choosing your puppy face-to-face. We source healthy, well-socialized puppies from trusted local breeders, ensuring they're raised with care, proper nutrition, and veterinary checks. Downtown Dubai Step 1 Explore our puppies Browse our website to view the available puppies. Each listing includes photos, breed details, age, and health information. Step 2 Choose your puppy Once you find a puppy you love, open their profile for more information or to enquire further. You can also reach out to us directly if you have any questions. Step 3 Meet before you choose Spend time bonding before making your decision. Step 4 Pick-up or delivery Pick up your puppy from us or have them delivered to your home within Dubai. Our delivery service is safe and reliable, ensuring your puppy arrives comfortably. Order upon request Looking for a truly exceptional companion? Our Order Upon Request service gives you access to some of the world's most sought-after teacup breeds — ethically sourced from the most reputable, certified breeders across Europe, Korea, and beyond. From Korean teacup poodles to rare Maltese, Pom, and Yorkie lines, we bring the world's finest puppies to Dubai, just for you. Europe · Korea Dubai Step 1 Reserve your puppy Browse our selection of available breeds and place a reservation for the teacup puppy that captures your heart. Our reservation-only model ensures that each puppy is specifically sourced to meet your preferences. Step 2 Personalized consultation Once your reservation is confirmed, we will work closely with you to finalize details and provide updates on your puppy's journey. Step 3 Import and arrival We manage all aspects of the import process, including health checks, travel arrangements, and necessary documentation. Your puppy will be carefully transported and will arrive ready to join your family. Step 4 Welcome home Upon arrival, we provide support to help your new puppy acclimate to their new environment. Our team is available for any additional assistance and to ensure a smooth transition into your home. puppy passport Our premium puppy promise Hand-selected breeders We work only with breeders who uphold the highest ethical and health standards. Worldwide delivery We safely deliver puppies to loving homes all around the world. Our mission is to make the entire adoption process smooth, transparent, and full of love. International cargo We safely deliver puppies to loving homes all around the world. From choosing your puppy to post-delivery support — we're just a message away. Health guarantee All our puppies come with a verified health certificate from licensed vets. We ensure every puppy is vaccinated, dewormed, and thoroughly checked before joining your family. text: Questions & answers Can't find what you're looking for? Message us on WhatsApp — our team is available 24/7. sniff out a question 9 notes on the board ? ! Ask your own question Are your puppies vaccinated and health-checked? Yes. All our puppies come with a verified health certificate from licensed vets. Every puppy is vaccinated, dewormed, and thoroughly checked before joining your family. Can I meet a puppy before I decide? Yes. Come meet our locally available puppies in our Downtown Dubai showroom and spend time bonding before making your decision. Can I take my puppy home the same day? Local puppies are available immediately, so you can take your puppy home the same day. Do you import puppies from abroad? Yes. Through our Order Upon Request service we source rare and premium teacup breeds from the most reputable, certified breeders across Europe, Korea, and beyond — and we handle the import for you. How does an imported puppy travel to Dubai? We manage every part of the import process, including health checks, travel arrangements, and the necessary documentation, so your puppy arrives happy, healthy, and stress-free. Will I see photos and health details first? Yes. Photos, videos, and health certificates are shared before your puppy travels, and our team sends real photos and health details directly on WhatsApp. Do you deliver? Yes. We deliver within Dubai, and our trusted international cargo partners deliver puppies safely to loving homes all around the world. Which breeds do you usually have? Breeds we regularly have include Maltipoo, Pomeranian, Poodle and Bichon, plus rare teacup lines such as Korean teacup poodles, Maltese, Pom and Yorkie. Is there help after my puppy comes home? Yes. Our team is available 24/7 and offers advice on training, nutrition, and general care to ensure a smooth transition for you and your new furry friend.
